item.description:
Dax 3.10.0

  • Every Dax artifact now opens on your phone too. When an agent shows a plan or a Quick View card on the Mac, it also comes up over the Dax app on your phone. You can answer it on either device, and the first answer settles it. Artifacts are drawn dark, in Inter, and fit a phone screen. HTML files no longer show up in Times.
  • When an agent asks a question, it now takes over the phone app. You can answer approvals from the phone, including the ones for secrets.
  • The live screen is now a remote control. Switch between Picture mode (look and zoom) and Control mode, talk to paste words where your Mac’s cursor is, bring Dax to the front, type, upload a photo or file, or open the Mac’s controls. Turn the phone on its side and the tools move into a rail beside the screen, and the controls open in two columns.
  • The mini Mac window on the Agents page can grow to half the screen, and tapping it opens the live screen.
  • From your phone you can start any agent installed on your Mac, either in a new tab or in an existing one. Queued prompts now show in the agent list, and you can send one from an agent’s hold menu. Hold an agent to upload a file to it, and its progress shows on the agent screen.
  • The Usage window now leads with how many credits you have left. When more than one copy of Dax is running, only one of them talks to your phone.
